messages.subject: lavaan WARNING: some estimated lv variances are negative
parts:
Hi all,

I'm running CFA with lavaan but my syntax keep saying 'lavaan WARNING: some estimated lv variances are negative'. My syntax is below:

model <- 'ai =~ c17 + c18 + c19 + c21

bi =~ c22 + c23 + c25 + c26

mi =~ c27 + c18 + c30 + c31

ci =~ c12 + c13 + c14 + c15

si =~ c32 + c33 + c34 + c35

rc =~ c08 + c09 + c10 + c11

lf =~ c37 + c38 + c39 + c41

ep =~ c47 + c48 + c49 + c50

ea =~ c42 + c43 + c45 + c46

 

ch =~ ai + bi + mi

ch ~~ 1*ch

ps =~ ep + lf

ps ~~ 1*ps

 

tt=~ ch + ci + si

tt ~~ 1*tt’

fit_model <- cfa(model, data = dataset)

semPaths(fit_model,layout="tree")



My syntax is fine when I don't put last two sentences "tt=~ ch+ci+si

                                                                                      tt ~~ 1*tt"


How can I fix it?


Many thanks to all!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavaan WARNING: some estimated lv variances are negative
parts:
My syntax is fine when I don't put last two sentences "tt=~ ch+ci+si

                                                                                      tt ~~ 1*tt"


How can I fix it?

Try only constraining either the factor variance or the first factor loading, not both.  Note that cfa() fixes the first factor loading to 1 by default, unless you tell it to fix factor variances instead using std.lv = TRUE.  Whatever is in your syntax will override what you tell the std.lv= argument, so you could free the loading using:

tt =~ NA*ch + ci + si
tt ~~ 1*tt
